title: IRC BNC - Bouncer System with Client-Server Architecture
instructions: Build a complete IRC BNC system where a bot client connects to IRC networks, and a server component allows external IRC clients (HexChat, irssi, etc.) to connect and take control. When connected, user commands proxy through to IRC; when disconnected, bot runs autonomously.

1783293068.6422002.instruction: Create project directory structure (irc_bnc/) with modules: client/, server/, shared/, config/. Define core classes: IrcClient (bot connection to IRC), BncServer (accepts client connections), UserSession (manages connected IRC clients), MessageRouter (routes between IRC and users). Implement configuration system for server port, bind address, IRC server details, authentication.

1783293068.6436713.instruction: Implement IrcClient class that connects to real IRC networks (Libera, EFnet, etc.). Features: nick identification, channel joining, message receiving, CTCP handling, auto-reconnect, SASL authentication. Store received messages in buffer for playback to connecting users. Run as background thread. Test connection to real IRC server.

1783293068.6438262.instruction: Implement BncServer that listens on configurable port (6667/6697). Accept connections from IRC clients (HexChat, irssi). Features: multiple simultaneous user connections, password authentication, capability negotiation (CAP), ping/pong handling. Each connection spawns UserSession thread. Test with HexChat connection.

1783293068.6439629.instruction: Implement UserSession class that bridges user<->IRC. Features: message buffering (playback missed messages), real-time relay (user commands → IRC), IRC events → user (PRIVMSG, JOIN, PART, etc.). Handle nick changes, channel lists, user lists (WHOIS). Detach mode: when user disconnects, bot continues, buffer messages. Reattach: send buffered history.

1783293068.644084.instruction: Implement authentication system: password-based, SSL/TLS support for server, certificate authentication, IP whitelist/blacklist, rate limiting. Store credentials securely (hashed). Implement /PASS, /NICK, /USER command handling. Test authentication with various IRC clients.

1783293068.6441996.instruction: Implement channel buffer system: each channel has message history (configurable size, e.g., 500 messages), separate buffers for queries (private messages). Features: buffer search, clear buffer, persistent storage (SQLite/JSON). Handle channel modes, bans, topics. Test buffer playback on client connect.

1783293068.6443255.instruction: Implement BNC admin commands: /BNC CONNECT server, /BNC DISCONNECT, /BNC STATUS, /BNC JUMP (reconnect), /BNC SAY (send as bot), /BNC RAW (send raw IRC). User management: /BNC ADDUSER, /BNC DELUSER, /BNC LISTUSERS. Network management: multiple IRC networks support. Test all commands.

1783293068.644455.instruction: Extend to support multiple IRC networks simultaneously: Libera, EFnet, OFTC, etc. Each network has separate IrcClient instance, separate buffers. Users can specify which network to control. Features: cross-network private messages, network status in status window. Test with 2+ networks.

1783293068.644588.instruction: Create optional web dashboard (Flask/FastAPI): view connection status, buffers, connected users, IRC networks. Features: web-based IRC client (WebSocket), configuration editing, logs viewer, statistics (messages/min, uptime). REST API for external integrations. Test web interface.

1783293068.6447208.instruction: Final integration testing: Connect bot to real IRC, connect HexChat to BNC, verify message relay, test disconnect/reconnect, buffer playback, multi-user scenarios, SSL connections, authentication failures. Create comprehensive documentation (README, configuration examples). Package for distribution (Docker, systemd service).
